name: model-shootout
description: Twelve short questions with one right answer, asked of several models. Run: regrade run examples/matrix/suite.json (needs OPENAI_API_KEY), then regrade matrix.

config.system: Answer with only the final answer: no explanation, no units, no trailing punctuation.

cases.input: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in cents?
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry?
It is 23:00. What time is it 150 minutes later? Answer as HH:MM in 24-hour time.
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many sheep are left?
Which is larger, 9.11 or 9.9? Answer with the number.
How many days are in February 2028?
What is the smallest prime number greater than 89?
If 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes, how many minutes do 100 machines need to make 100 widgets?
How many letters are in the word Mississippi?
What day of the week was 1 January 2000?
